description: Meguiar's - TJ Hunt & Co Collection and TJ Hunt Kit, Perfect Detailing Kit for Cleaning and Protecting Interior and Exterior Surfaces, with Limited Hunt & Co Gear and Microfiber Accessories - Distributed/Packaged by Meguiar'S. Product Details: With this limited collection of works we partnered with the engaging automotive vlogger, influencing, and entrepreneur TJ Hunt! It's not enough to say you're passionate about cars and car community! With hand-selected products from Hunt & Co and Meguiar, you will receive cool Hunt & Co hardware, as well as the right premium products to clean, polish and protect a variety of surfaces inside and around your ride. Perfect for quick cleaning and finishing, Ultimate Waterless Wash & Wax removes fresh and light dust and contaminants while enhancing brightness and providing additional wax protection. This waterless cleaner is ideal for touching a few days after washing or just before hitting local cars and coffee. This car kit is our Ultimate Wash & Wax for regular washing and wax protection to maintain shine. Provides thick foams for gentle washing, leaving a deep, shiny, only waxed sheen, and leaving behind the carnauba and synthetic polymer wax protection. Your ride is not completely clean unless the wheels are clean either. Ultimate All Wheel Cleaner is an excellent choice for removing heavy brake dust, dirt and dirt quickly, and is pH neutral and acid free, making it safe and effective on all wheel trims and painted brake components. For finishes and easy cleaning, we have also included our Quik Interior Detailer to clean all interior surfaces quickly. It also contains sunblock substances to maintain the original look of the internal components without an oily look or feel. With the professional, ready-to-use formula, D107 Citrus Power Cleaner Plus RTU remove dirt, dirt and stains on interior and exterior surfaces including carpet, upholstery, plastic, upholstery parts and more. We throw away the towels! This package also includes three premium microfiber towels to gently spread and remove a variety of detailing products, and a microfiber wash glove to ensure you get the shiny, swirl-free results you want during washing and a microfiber towel for soft drying. Let's forget all limited-edition beauty, such as Hunt & Co poster, collaboration hat, flight tag and keychain and stickers! Get this inclusive car detailing kit before you go and show your passion while making your ride clean and bright!
